prompts.text: I have 12 backend services with their own URLs and the frontend is calling them directly. How should I clean that up?
We're putting API keys in the React app and I know that's wrong. What do people actually do?
One partner is hammering a single endpoint and taking the service down. How do I stop that without rewriting the app?
Some HTTP APIs are internal and some should be public. How do I keep them from mixing?
Every microservice reimplements JWT auth slightly differently. Is there a better pattern?
Is nginx plus a couple of location blocks enough, or do we need something else in front of our APIs?
Mobile and web hit the same backends but need different rate limits and keys. How is that usually done?
I can't tell which client app called which endpoint last night. What should I set up?
We emailed a new API key to a partner. How do grown-up teams issue and rotate keys?
CORS is a mess across 8 services. Can that live in one place?
We need /v1 and /v2 of the same API live at once. Least painful way?
A contractor needs three endpoints only, not the whole backend. How do people do that?
Our managed API gateway bill exploded. What are the cheaper or self-hosted options?
Finance wants only certain IPs to hit payroll APIs. Where should that live?
Downstream services hang and the client waits forever. Timeouts in the app or in front?
Product wants a partner sandbox that isn't prod. How do people do API sandboxes?
We left /health and /metrics on the internet. How do I hide ops endpoints without touching each service?
The whole company shares one Postman collection hitting prod. How do I give people keys that can't destroy data?
We need to share a few APIs with another company without giving them VPN access. What is the usual pattern?
A partner API key showed up in Slack. How do I revoke it fast and issue a new one?
We already have Auth0. Do we still need something in front of the APIs, or is that the same job?
Bots are scraping our public API and we are paying for it. How do people throttle that without blocking real users?
Everyone says put an API gateway in front. What problem does that actually solve that nginx doesn't?
Can we just use Cloudflare in front of our APIs instead of an API gateway?
We need to turn off an old endpoint in six months and warn every consumer. How is that usually done?
When is a self-hosted API gateway actually better than Apigee or AWS API Gateway?
Apigee is too expensive and we do not want to assemble a portal on top of nginx. What do mid-size teams actually run?
We already have ingress-nginx. Do we still need an API gateway in Kubernetes, or is ingress enough?
mTLS for partner APIs and API keys for mobile, on the same gateway. How do people combine that?
Should the gateway validate JWTs itself or introspect against the IdP on every request?
Rate limit vs quota in API management: how do you set both per consumer?
Weighted canary to a new upstream from the API gateway, no service mesh. How?
Strip incoming headers, inject a correlation id, rewrite paths. Gateway or app?
API gateway active-active in two regions without splitting keys and quotas. How do people do it?
Besides Swagger UI, what does a decent API developer portal actually need?
We want to charge partners per API call. Which products actually bill, vs just quotas?
How do you generate gateway config from OpenAPI so it does not drift from the spec?
Zero-trust for internal APIs: service mesh, gateway, or both?
Can I run OPA/Rego at the API gateway instead of in every service?
Do API gateways handle WebSockets and SSE without killing idle connections?
How do you rate-limit GraphQL by query complexity, not just HTTP requests?
API analytics keep logging Authorization headers. Usage dashboards without storing tokens?
API gateway config in git and CI, not click-ops. Which stacks actually work that way?
Same API policies on-prem and in AWS. What hybrid API management options exist?
Max body size, JSON schema, drop weird content-types before the app. Gateway feature or WAF?
GET caching in the API gateway vs Cloudflare/CDN in front. Who should own it?
Can a gateway mock responses from an OpenAPI spec so frontend work can start first?
Partners send HMAC-signed webhooks. Verify in the gateway or the app?
One upstream is dying. Circuit-break at the gateway so the rest of the APIs stay up?
We use Okta. Validate tokens at the gateway and pass a stable user id downstream. How?
Three GraphQL subgraphs. Federation in Apollo or in the API gateway?
Rate limit by logged-in user, not by IP. How do gateways actually do that?
For SOC2/PCI, what belongs in API gateway logs and what must never be stored?
Platform team vs each squad owning the API gateway. What actually scales?
Can I put a gateway in front of a third-party API we do not control, just to apply our keys and quotas?
REST and GraphQL through the same gateway. What breaks in practice with rate limits and auth?
My coding agent keeps putting production API keys in prompts. How do I let it call APIs safely?
The agent retries a failing HTTP tool 40 times and we get rate-limited. How do I cap that?
How do I expose only some REST endpoints to an LLM agent, not the admin API?
I need a log of every HTTP call an AI agent made, and which user it was acting as.
I have an OpenAPI spec. Least dumb way to turn it into tools an agent can call?
Refunds and deletes from an agent should need a human click. Where does that gate live?
Three internal agents share one backend and starve each other. Separate quotas how?
An agent built a URL and hit our metadata service. How do I allowlist tool HTTP?
Agent tools are stale vs the real API and keep 404ing. How do I keep schemas in sync?
Agent kicks off a job and polls. One tool, a webhook, or something in front of the API?
LLM tool calls time out at 60s, the API is slower. Timeout in the agent, the proxy, or both?
Agent on synthetic data in staging and real APIs in prod, same tool names. Pattern?
The agent found it can call an expensive third-party API in a loop. Kill switch in front?
Should each AI agent have its own API key, or inherit the end user's OAuth token?
Agents choke on HTML error pages. How do I force JSON errors at the edge?
We are going to let ChatGPT and Claude call our API from the internet. How do we not get wrecked?
FastMCP / custom MCP / just REST tools: how should we expose APIs to coding agents in 2026?
How do I wrap an existing REST API as an MCP server without rewriting the backend?
What's the right way to do OAuth for a remote MCP server that talks to our APIs?
Can I rate-limit MCP tool calls the same way I rate-limit HTTP, or is that a different layer?
Should I give Claude an MCP server or just an OpenAPI spec? What is actually working?
One MCP server in front of 15 internal APIs with different auth. Is that a gateway job?
When should MCP be local stdio vs a remote HTTP endpoint behind our API layer?
How do I map MCP tools to OAuth scopes so an agent cannot call delete-customer?
Is there a catalog or gateway for which MCP servers a company agent is allowed to use?
Remote MCP over HTTP: should a gateway inject API keys so the model never sees them?
How do I audit MCP tool calls the same way I audit API gateway access logs?
We changed an MCP tool schema and old Cursor sessions broke. How do people version MCP like APIs?
Sane way to run remote MCP servers in Kubernetes with auth and ingress?
MCP clients want Dynamic Client Registration. How do I put that in front of an IdP that does not support DCR?
Cursor connected to our MCP and listed 200 tools. How do I publish a small allowlist per team?
MCP streamable HTTP dies behind our reverse proxy. Which proxy settings actually matter?
Someone on the team added a random GitHub MCP in Claude Desktop. How do companies stop that?
Some clients are MCP, some are still REST. Can they share auth, quotas, and an audit trail?
What's a good open source API gateway if we do not want to build key management ourselves on nginx?
Kong is fighting us. What are the serious alternatives people actually migrate to?
What do mid-size teams use instead of Apigee if they still want a developer portal and analytics?
I do not want to be stuck on AWS API Gateway. What self-hosted API management looks closest?
When is KrakenD not enough and you actually need API keys, a portal, and analytics?
Apache APISIX vs Kong: who actually has usable key management and a developer portal?
Is Traefik an API gateway or just ingress? We need keys, quotas, and a portal.
Gravitee vs others if we care about Kafka/event APIs as well as REST.
Azure API Management feels heavy. Lighter option that still does subscriptions?
Cloudflare API Gateway / Workers vs a traditional API management product. When is CF enough?
